HediffDef.label: gouged control port
HediffDef.description: Its control port has been gouged out by its own tool-hand. It cannot be given to anyone, or controlled from anywhere.

HediffDef.label: tally scratches
HediffDef.description: A tally is scratched across its inner plating, thousands of strokes. It keeps counting days aloud.

HediffDef.label: welded sealed box
HediffDef.description: Its hauling frame is welded around a sealed box it never opened.

HediffDef.label: voice box removed
HediffDef.description: Its voice box was removed by hand, neatly. It speaks only in tones.

HediffDef.label: lichen seams
HediffDef.description: Wreck-lichen has been cultivated in its seams, on purpose.

HediffDef.label: grafted limb
HediffDef.description: An extra limb from another chassis is grafted on. It works faster, and breaks more.

HediffDef.label: oversized array
HediffDef.description: Its receiver array has been grown oversized.
